UserObject.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam class {
    BorderThickness 1.5
    ArrowColor #424242
    FontColor #212121
}

' ===== CURRENCY & PRICING (Cyan) =====
entity currencies #E0F7FA {
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<PK>>
    --
    * currency_name : VARCHAR(100)
    * symbol : VARCHAR(10)
    * decimal_places : INT <<DF 2>>
    * is_base_currency : BOOLEAN <<DF FALSE>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity exchange_rates #E0F7FA {
    * rate_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * from_currency : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * to_currency : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * rate : DECIMAL(18,6)
    * rate_type : ENUM('OFFICIAL','PARALLEL','BLENDED')
    * effective_date : DATE
    --
    <<UQ>> (from_currency, to_currency, rate_type, effective_date)
}

entity product_prices #E0F7FA {
    * price_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * price_type : ENUM('RETAIL','WHOLESALE','BULK')
    * price : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * effective_from : DATE
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
    --
    <<UQ>> (product_id, currency_code, price_type)
}

' ===== PRODUCT CATALOG (Blue) =====
entity product_categories #E3F2FD {
    * category_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * category_name : VARCHAR(100)
    * parent_category_id : INT <<FK>> <<NULL>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity units_of_measure #E3F2FD {
    * uom_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * uom_code : VARCHAR(20) <<UQ>>
    * uom_name : VARCHAR(100)
}

entity products #E3F2FD {
    * product_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * sku : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
    * barcode : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>> <<NULL>>
    * product_name : VARCHAR(255)
    * description : TEXT <<NULL>>
    * category_id : INT <<FK>>
    * uom_id : INT <<FK>>
    * vat_category_id : INT <<FK>>
    * track_inventory : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

' ===== INVENTORY (Green) =====
entity warehouses #E8F5E9 {
    * warehouse_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * warehouse_code : VARCHAR(20) <<UQ>>
    * warehouse_name : VARCHAR(100)
    * location : VARCHAR(255) <<NULL>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity inventory #E8F5E9 {
    * inventory_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3) <<DF 0>>
    * average_cost : DECIMAL(18,4) <<DF 0>>
    * cost_currency : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * reorder_level : DECIMAL(18,3) <<DF 0>>
    * updated_at : TIMESTAMP
    --
    <<UQ>> (product_id, warehouse_id)
}

entity inventory_transactions #E8F5E9 {
    * transaction_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * transaction_type : ENUM('PURCHASE','SALE','ADJUSTMENT','RETURN','TRANSFER')
    * reference_type : ENUM('SALE','PO','GRN','ADJUSTMENT','TRANSFER')
    * reference_id : INT
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3)
    * unit_cost : DECIMAL(18,4) <<NULL>>
    * transaction_date : TIMESTAMP
    * notes : TEXT <<NULL>>
}

' ===== PROCUREMENT (Amber) =====
entity suppliers #FFF8E1 {
    * supplier_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * supplier_name : VARCHAR(200)
    * phone : VARCHAR(20) <<NULL>>
    * email : VARCHAR(255) <<NULL>>
    * address : TEXT <<NULL>>
    * payment_terms_days : INT <<DF 30>>
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity purchase_orders #FFF8E1 {
    * po_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * po_number : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
    * supplier_id : INT <<FK>>
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * order_date : DATE
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * exchange_rate : DECIMAL(18,6)
    * total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * status : ENUM('DRAFT','SENT','PARTIAL','RECEIVED','CANCELLED')
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

entity po_items #FFF8E1 {
    * po_item_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * po_id : INT <<FK>>
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3)
    * unit_price : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * line_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
}

entity goods_receipts #FFF8E1 {
    * grn_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * grn_number : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
    * po_id : INT <<FK>> <<NULL>>
    * supplier_id : INT <<FK>>
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * receipt_date : DATE
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * status : ENUM('PENDING','POSTED','CANCELLED')
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

entity grn_items #FFF8E1 {
    * grn_item_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * grn_id : INT <<FK>>
    * po_item_id : INT <<FK>> <<NULL>>
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3)
    * unit_cost : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * line_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
}

' ===== CUSTOMERS & SALES (Red) =====
entity customers #FFEBEE {
    * customer_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * customer_name : VARCHAR(200)
    * phone : VARCHAR(20) <<NULL>>
    * email : VARCHAR(255) <<NULL>>
    * address : TEXT <<NULL>>
    * credit_limit : DECIMAL(18,4) <<DF 0>>
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity sales #FFEBEE {
    * sale_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * sale_number : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
    * customer_id : INT <<FK>> <<NULL>>
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * sale_date : TIMESTAMP
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * exchange_rate : DECIMAL(18,6)
    * subtotal : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * vat_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * discount_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * payment_status : ENUM('PENDING','PAID','CANCELLED')
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

entity sale_items #FFEBEE {
    * sale_item_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * sale_id : INT <<FK>>
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3)
    * unit_price : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * unit_cost : DECIMAL(18,4) <<NULL>>
    * vat_rate : DECIMAL(5,2)
    * vat_amount : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * line_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
}

entity payments #FFEBEE {
    * payment_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * sale_id : INT <<FK>>
    * payment_method : ENUM('CASH','ECOCASH','ZIPIT','BANK_TRANSFER','CARD','USD_CASH','ZiG_CASH','INNWALLET','OMARI')
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * amount : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * exchange_rate : DECIMAL(18,6)
    * reference_number : VARCHAR(100) <<NULL>>
    * payment_date : TIMESTAMP
}

' ===== ZIMRA TAX & INVOICING (Purple) =====
entity vat_categories #F3E5F5 {
    * vat_category_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * category_name : VARCHAR(100)
    * vat_rate : DECIMAL(5,2)
    * is_active : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
}

entity invoices #F3E5F5 {
    * invoice_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * sale_id : INT <<FK>>
    * invoice_number : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>>
    * zimra_invoice_number : VARCHAR(50) <<UQ>> <<NULL>>
    * fiscal_device_id : VARCHAR(50) <<NULL>>
    * fiscal_signature : VARCHAR(500) <<NULL>>
    * customer_id : INT <<FK>>
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * exchange_rate : DECIMAL(18,6)
    * subtotal : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * vat_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * total : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * invoice_date : TIMESTAMP
    * status : ENUM('DRAFT','FISCALISED','CANCELLED','CREDIT_NOTE')
    * submitted_to_zimra : BOOLEAN <<DF FALSE>>
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

entity invoice_items #F3E5F5 {
    * invoice_item_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * invoice_id : INT <<FK>>
    * sale_item_id : INT <<FK>>
    * product_id : INT <<FK>>
    * description : TEXT <<NULL>>
    * quantity : DECIMAL(18,3)
    * unit_price : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * vat_rate : DECIMAL(5,2)
    * vat_amount : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * line_total : DECIMAL(18,4)
}

entity vat_records #F3E5F5 {
    * vat_record_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * invoice_id : INT <<FK>>
    * vat_category_id : INT <<FK>>
    * taxable_amount : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * vat_rate : DECIMAL(5,2)
    * vat_amount : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * tax_period : VARCHAR(7)
    * submitted_to_zimra : BOOLEAN <<DF FALSE>>
    * zimra_ack_code : VARCHAR(100) <<NULL>>
}

' ===== STOCK CONTROL (Deep Orange) =====
entity stock_adjustments #FFE0B2 {
    * adjustment_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * adjustment_date : DATE
    * reason : VARCHAR(255)
    * total_value_impact : DECIMAL(18,4)
    * currency_code : CHAR(3) <<FK>>
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

entity stock_transfers #FFE0B2 {
    * transfer_id : INT <<PK>> <<AUTO>>
    --
    * from_warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * to_warehouse_id : INT <<FK>>
    * transfer_date : DATE
    * status : ENUM('PENDING','IN_TRANSIT','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
    * created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

' ===== RELATIONSHIPS =====
currencies ||--o{ exchange_rates : from
currencies ||--o{ exchange_rates : to
currencies ||--o{ product_prices
currencies ||--o{ inventory
currencies ||--o{ suppliers
currencies ||--o{ purchase_orders
currencies ||--o{ goods_receipts
currencies ||--o{ customers
currencies ||--o{ sales
currencies ||--o{ payments
currencies ||--o{ invoices
currencies ||--o{ stock_adjustments

vat_categories ||--o{ products
vat_categories ||--o{ vat_records

product_categories ||--o{ product_categories : parent
product_categories ||--o{ products

units_of_measure ||--o{ products

products ||--o{ product_prices
products ||--o{ inventory
products ||--o{ inventory_transactions
products ||--o{ po_items
products ||--o{ grn_items
products ||--o{ sale_items
products ||--o{ invoice_items

warehouses ||--o{ inventory
warehouses ||--o{ inventory_transactions
warehouses ||--o{ purchase_orders
warehouses ||--o{ goods_receipts
warehouses ||--o{ sales
warehouses ||--o{ stock_adjustments
warehouses ||--o{ stock_transfers : from
warehouses ||--o{ stock_transfers : to

purchase_orders ||--o{ po_items
purchase_orders ||--o{ goods_receipts

po_items ||--o{ grn_items

goods_receipts ||--o{ grn_items

customers ||--o{ sales
customers ||--o{ invoices

sales ||--o{ sale_items
sales ||--o{ payments

invoices ||--o{ vat_records

note right of exchange_rates
  **Zimbabwe Multi-Currency Setup**
  - Pre-seed: USD (base), ZiG
  - OFFICIAL: RBZ / ZIMRA daily rate
  - PARALLEL: Street/market rate
  - BLENDED: Weighted average
  - Keep 30 days max; archive older rates
end note

note right of payments
  **Zimbabwe-Specific Methods**
  - USD_CASH & ZiG_CASH (physical cash jars)
  - ECOCASH, ZIPIT, INNWALLET, OMARI
  - BANK_TRANSFER, CARD
  - Always capture reference_number for mobile money
end note

note right of inventory
  **Average Cost (No FIFO)**
  - average_cost updated on every GRN posting:
    new_avg = ((old_qty * old_avg) + (new_qty * new_cost)) / (old_qty + new_qty)
  - unit_cost in sale_items = average_cost at time of sale
  - Simple, low-tech, tax-compliant for ZIMRA
end note

note right of invoices
  **ZIMRA Fiscalisation (Offline-First)**
  - fiscal_device_id + fiscal_signature stored when fiscalised
  - zimra_invoice_number assigned by ZIMRA
  - submitted_to_zimra = FALSE until synced
  - Works offline; batch-submit when internet returns
end note

note bottom of products
  **Low-Tech Index Recommendations**
  - products(sku, barcode, category_id)
  - product_prices(product_id, currency_code, is_active)
  - inventory(product_id, warehouse_id)
  - inventory_transactions(product_id, warehouse_id, transaction_date)
  - sales(sale_number, customer_id, sale_date)
  - sale_items(sale_id, product_id)
  - invoices(invoice_number, zimra_invoice_number, sale_id)
  - vat_records(tax_period, submitted_to_zimra)
  - exchange_rates(from_currency, to_currency, effective_date, rate_type)
end note

@enduml",
  "config": null
}
